comment: Dr.VR is a nice guy, but his class probably wasn't for me. Course was graded heavily on the midterm and final paper. If you don't do well on those two assignments it's hard to get an 'A'. Class was boring at points & required lots of out of class reading & quizzes. He's super passionate but class was less about leadership & more about anthropology.

dr vr is such a funny guy and a great prof, he always had engaging lectures and not too much hw. midterm was the hardest part of the class and definitely needed a lot of studying for but besides that, the class was more laid back.

Classes are based on lectures and reading, and readings are from required books so no need for textbooks. Lectures can be interesting but can also be pretty long/boring too. Assignments are not that hard and participation is not required/that important.

Dr. von Reuden had very unclear expectations for the course. He's also really smart, but has trouble simplifying abstract concepts for us to understand. Most of the time, I would leave class more confused than when I entered. You have to read a lot for class and your final grade will be determined on the final paper, which you get no guidance on.

vonRueden is a nice guy and a good professor! His class can be kind of boring, especially if people don't participate, but the subject matter is really interesting! You don't have to read everything and if you put effort in during class, for couple of tests, for the one paper and the reading responses it's easy to get an A
